Software developed through research and teaching. Unless otherwise noted, the
repositories are public on [github.com/gcastellazzi](https://github.com/gcastellazzi).

## From survey data to structural models

### Cloud2FEM {#cloud2fem}

The procedure that enables finite element modelling starting from a cloud of
points. Slices the cloud, reconstructs the geometry of the structure and builds
a voxel-based mesh ready for analysis.

Python ·
[Repository](https://github.com/gcastellazzi/Cloud2FEM){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}
[Portable version](https://github.com/gcastellazzi/Cloud2FEM-portable){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .btn-sm}

### C2F4DT — PETRAS {#c2f4dt}

The successor to Cloud2FEM: an integrated environment that organises, processes
and visualises survey data together with the structural models derived from it,
towards a digital twin of the existing building.

### PETRAS-ontology {#petras-ontology}

Provenance graph viewer and project tooling for the PETRAS ontology: keeps track
of where every piece of data in a digital-twin project comes from and how it was
transformed.

TypeScript ·
[Live viewer](https://gcastellazzi.github.io/PETRAS-ontology/){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}
[Repository](https://github.com/gcastellazzi/PETRAS-ontology){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

## Finite elements and error estimation

### FinEtoolsFlexStructures.jl {#finetools}

Finite element tools in Julia for the analysis of flexible structures: beams and
shells. Part of the `FinEtools` ecosystem.

Julia · MIT ·
[Repository](https://github.com/gcastellazzi/FinEtoolsFlexStructures.jl){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

### GCEEFEM {#gceefem}

The Gram-Channel Error Estimator (GCEE): an a-priori error estimator for finite
element solutions.

[Repository](https://github.com/gcastellazzi/GCEEFEM.jl){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

### SAPT {#sapt}

Simulia Abaqus Python Tools — scripts and utilities for driving Abaqus models
from Python: pre-processing, parametric studies and extraction of results.

Python ·
[Repository](https://github.com/gcastellazzi/SAPT){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

## Educational software

### The Masonry Archive {#masonry-archive}

An open, moderated archive of geolocated masonry images for teaching, public
consultation and research documentation. The interactive map collects masonry
textures, structural details and construction periods, with optional aLoTiA
records. Contributions are reviewed before publication.

TypeScript ·
[Explore the archive](https://gcastellazzi.github.io/theMasonryArchive/){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}
[Repository](https://github.com/gcastellazzi/theMasonryArchive){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}
[Dataset DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22698617){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .btn-sm}

### aLOTofImaginArches {#alotia}

Interactive graphical statics of masonry arches, in the browser. Load a
photograph of a real arch, trace intrados and extrados, subdivide the ring into
voussoirs, hang loads on it, and move the line of thrust through its three
degrees of freedom while the software checks joint by joint whether it stays
inside the masonry.

Written for the master's courses *Mechanics of Historical Masonry Structures*
and *Historical Masonry and Wooden Structures* at the University of Bologna.
Nothing to install: a static web page, plain ES modules, no build step and no
dependencies.

JavaScript · MIT ·
[Open the app](https://gcastellazzi.github.io/aLoTiA/app/){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}
[User guide](https://gcastellazzi.github.io/aLoTiA/){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}
[Repository](https://github.com/gcastellazzi/aLoTiA){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

### UnBaAct {#unbact}

An interactive laboratory for exploring the equilibrium of granular and
masonry structures. Build or trace two-dimensional block assemblies, vary
friction, gravity, supports and loads, then observe contact forces, force chains
and collapse mechanisms directly in the browser.

JavaScript ·
[Open the app](https://gcastellazzi.github.io/UnBaAct/){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}
[Repository](https://github.com/gcastellazzi/UnBaAct){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

### rapidMQI {#rapidmqi}

A field-oriented teaching tool for assessing the Masonry Quality Index from
photographs. It guides the user through the seven parameters of the Borri and
De Maria method, calculates the index for vertical, in-plane and out-of-plane
actions, and reports the corresponding masonry class and mechanical-property
ranges. It also works offline on a phone.

JavaScript · MIT ·
[Open the app](https://gcastellazzi.github.io/rapidMQI/app/){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}
[User guide](https://gcastellazzi.github.io/rapidMQI/){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}
[Repository](https://github.com/gcastellazzi/rapidMQI){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}
